card.heard: How would you structure the Android app?
card.say: I'd use a layered structure with clear boundaries. The UI layer has the feed and detail screens, each with its own ViewModel. Below that, use cases hold the domain logic, and the repository sits under them. The repository reads from two local sources and one remote source. card.heard: 200 MB cache limit and logout
card.say: I'd keep the 200 MB limit in the local store, not in the UI. Every write goes through one place, so after each insert I check the total size. When it goes over, I delete the oldest posts first, because the feed is read newest first. On logout I clear the whole database and the in-memory store, and I cancel any pending sync. That way the next user never sees the old user's posts.
